behavior_boundary.primary_axis: behavior phase before metaprogramming expansion, synthesized artifact, module replay, interop call, FFI metadata, closure/error boundary, source-owner contract, report, package, or workflow
behavior_boundary.support_authority: metaprogramming and interop closure rows are source, acceptance, package, probe, and provenance evidence only until parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e behavior owner split claims the phase
behavior_boundary.generated_report_rule: runtime reports, runnable conformance/e2e summaries, package artifacts, runtime-import artifacts, module replay rows, FFI metadata rows, closure/error composition rows, cache snapshots, and generated bridge payloads cannot define canonical support
behavior_boundary.retired_surface_rule: compatibility, gate, retired route, old-mode, migration-only, unsupported property behavior, unsupported foreign loader topology, public ABI widening, stale acceptance, evidence-log, and generated-evidence-log evidence is canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
behavior_boundary.evidence_boundary_rule: metaprogramming expansion, synthesized artifacts, module replay, interop calls, FFI metadata, closure/error boundaries, runtime acceptance reports, public workflows, generated bridge payloads, package manifests, runtime-import artifacts, and cache snapshots are distinct evidence classes; only a canonical behavior owner can promote matching hand-authored behavior truth

metaprogramming_runtime_owner.support_boundary: metaprogramming claims require semantic, lowering, IR, and runtime owner assignment; expansion summaries, synthesized artifacts, module replay, cache snapshots, runtime-import artifacts, and generated reports stay provenance unless the behavior owner claims support; unsupported macro topologies remain fail-closed evidence

property_behavior_owner.support_boundary: property behavior support requires semantic legality, lowering helper selection, runtime materialization, and packaged evidence; synthesized-accessor artifacts, generated materialization reports, module replay rows, and storage reflection metadata are provenance until claimed by a behavior owner; unsupported combinations and storage retired route claims stay rejection evidence

interop_runtime_owner.support_boundary: mixed-image and C/C++/Swift bridge compatibility names, interop-call labels, FFI metadata, bridge payloads, and module replay rows are narrow packaged-proof provenance until parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners claim support; broader compatibility remains canonical rejection

metaprogramming_lowering_owner.support_boundary: lowering/runtime artifact rows bind host-cache, synthesized-artifact, module-replay, and runtime-import provenance; generated reports, cache snapshots, and replay manifests cannot create support

runtime_abi_packaged_proof_owner.support_boundary: packaged proof is runtime/e2e evidence only when package artifacts, bridge payloads, interop probes, FFI metadata, closure/error composition rows, and module replay stay coupled with canonical behavior owners; evidence-log, generated-only, or stale acceptance remains rejection/provenance

current_gaps: property-behavior runtime materialization is still bounded by metaprogramming runtime-boundary and lowering probes rather than a dedicated public runtime ABI

integration surfaces for runnable interop are still marked stale-or-missing relative to the acceptance report
explicit_non_goals: public runtime ABI widening for macro host execution or package loader helpers
claiming unsupported property-behavior combinations as runtime complete
claiming unsupported foreign loader topologies or unsupported bridge ecosystems as live
